notes.title: Official Steam Achievement Update
notes.notes:
I didn't think it was possible with this old an engine but Cyanic delivered. This update is thanks to them.

46 Achievements both in game and on steam. 

Also did some late game balancing and bug fixes. 

Enjoy.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Small bug fixes, some related to quest book and some not.

notes.title: The Last Island of Man Version 1.9 release
notes.notes:
This is the biggest visual upgrade yet. With the help of the community a few early game features look a little prettier.

New Font
Minor Dialog edits
11 new character models and faces
Title screen animation
New window skin
Streamlined class selection

notes.title: The Last Islands of Man Version 1.65 release
notes.notes:
New Quest Book to help you keep track of where you've been and what you're doing. It only helps to organize, the heavy lifting is still up to you.

Late game class balancing

Various small bug fixes

notes.title: The Last Islands of Man 1.5 release
notes.notes: I've implemented Sound options in the menu and done some late game balancing.

notes.title: Major update 1.4
notes.notes:
Major Update 1.4

A few new art assets introduced.

Minor story extension, including hints for final puzzle.

Minor bug fixes.
